an10.95:1.1: athakho uttiyo paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an10.95:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho uttiyo paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an10.95:1.3: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama sassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti.
an10.95:2.1: kiṃ pana bho gotama assassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti.
an10.95:3.1: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama antavā loko …
an10.95:3.7: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā …
an10.95:3.8: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti.
an10.95:3.10: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti.
an10.95:4.1: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama sassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti iti puṭṭho samāno abyākataṃ kho etaṃ uttiya mayā
an10.95:4.2: sassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti vadesi
an10.95:5.1: kiṃ pana bho gotama assassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti iti puṭṭho samāno
an10.95:5.2: etampi kho uttiya abyākataṃ mayā assassato loko idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti vadesi
an10.95:6.1: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama antavā loko …
an10.95:6.7: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā …
an10.95:6.8: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti iti puṭṭho samāno
an10.95:6.10: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti vadesi
an10.95:7.1: abhiññā kho ahaṃ uttiya sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desemi sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
an10.95:8.1: yaṃ panetaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo abhiññā sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desesi sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya sabbo vā tena loko niyyāssati upaḍḍho vā tibhāgo vā
an10.95:9.2: māheva kho uttiyo paribbājako pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ paṭilabhi
an10.95:9.3: sabbaṃ sāmukkaṃsikaṃ vata me samaṇo gotamo pañhaṃ puṭṭho saṃsādeti no visajjeti nūna na visahatīti
an10.95:9.4: tadassa uttiyassa paribbājakassa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti
an10.95:10.1: athakho āyasmā ānando uttiyaṃ paribbājakaṃ etadavoca
an10.95:10.3: upamāyamidhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti
an10.95:10.4: seyyathāpi āvuso uttiya rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ taṃ daḷhaddālaṃ daḷhapākāratoraṇaṃ ekadvāraṃ
an10.95:10.5: tatrassa dovāriko paṇḍito byatto medhāvī aññātānaṃ nivāretā ñātānaṃ pavesetā
an10.95:10.6: so tassa nagarassa samantā anupariyāyapathaṃ anukkamamāno na passeyya pākārasandhiṃ vā pākāravivaraṃ vā antamaso viḷāranissakanamattampi
an10.95:10.7: no ca khvāssa evaṃ ñāṇaṃ hoti ettakā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vāti.
an10.95:10.8: atha khvāssa evamettha hoti ye kho keci oḷārikā pāṇā imaṃ nagaraṃ pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vā sabbe te iminā dvārena pavisanti vā nikkhamanti vāti
an10.95:11.1: evameva kho āvuso uttiya na tathāgatassa evaṃ ussukkataṃ hoti sabbo vā tena loko niyyāssati upaḍḍho vā tibhāgo vāti.
an10.95:11.2: athakho evamettha tathāgatassa hoti ye kho keci lokamhā niyyiṃsu vā niyyanti vā niyyāssanti vā sabbe te pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā satta bojjhaṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā
an10.95:11.3: evamete lokamhā niyyiṃsu vā niyyanti vā niyyāssanti vāti.
an10.95:11.4: yadeva kho tvaṃ āvuso uttiya bhagavantaṃ imaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi tadevetaṃ pañhaṃ bhagavantaṃ aññena pariyāyena apucchi
an10.95:11.5: tasmā te taṃ bhagavā na byākāsīti.
